sample_reviews.author: Michael T
sample_reviews.text: DFB fitted a new boiler for us quickly and professionally. Brilliant service from start to finish — would highly recommend to anyone in Liverpool.

sample_reviews.author: Sarah L
sample_reviews.text: Called out for a heating emergency and they arrived within a couple of hours. Friendly, knowledgeable and very fairly priced. Excellent company.

sample_reviews.author: James R
sample_reviews.text: Had my annual boiler service done by DFB Heating. Really thorough job and they gave useful advice on improving my home's energy efficiency. Great lads.

brand.usp: DFB Heating and Energy Ltd combines expert gas engineering with a genuine focus on energy efficiency, helping Liverpool homeowners stay warm while reducing their energy bills. We're Gas Safe registered and committed to honest, reliable service every time.
brand.hero_headline: Expert Heating and Gas Engineers in Liverpool
brand.about_paragraph: We're DFB Heating and Energy Ltd, based right here in Liverpool on Penny Lane, and we're proud to serve homeowners and businesses across the local area. From new boiler installations to full central heating systems and gas safety checks, we bring expertise, reliability and a friendly face to every job. Our focus on energy efficiency means we don't just fix problems — we help you save money in the long run.
